title: Autonomy Docker Base Images
subtitle: base images of the Autonomy Node product images — autonomy-base, autonomy-python-base, autonomy-node-base
advisorySource: Debian Security Tracker and other OSV sources via osv-scanner (OSV) image scanning
_note_ids: Every triage entry lists the advisory ids it accounts for. build-report.mjs cross-checks the live post-suppression scan against these: an advisory no entry claims is reported in section 4a as untriaged.
_note_counts: advisories/counts describe the last FULL assessment (assessedAt) and are only rendered when the report is built without a live scan. With --osv-raw/--osv-delta the numbers come from that run.
headline: Initial baseline. No triage decision has been recorded yet; the figures in the Key metrics table come from the live scan of this run, and any advisory it surfaces is listed as untriaged until it is assessed.
scope: This repository builds the base images of the Autonomy Node product images and publishes them to ghcr.io/autonomy-logic: autonomy-base (Debian 13 slim on a pinned Debian snapshot), and autonomy-python-base and autonomy-node-base built on it. This assessment covers the Debian packages installed in every image listed in images.conf, built from this commit for linux/amd64. Package names carry the image as a prefix, e.g. autonomy-node-base/curl.
scopeNote: Not covered by the scan: the Node.js binary that autonomy-node-base copies from the pinned node:22-bookworm-slim image (it is listed in the SBOM, but OSV has no Node.js runtime advisories), and the linux/arm64 and linux/arm/v7 builds, which install the same Debian package versions from the same snapshot.
methodologyNote: Each image is built with docker buildx bake from the committed Dockerfiles for linux/amd64 and exported as an image archive. osv-scanner reads the dpkg database of each archive and checks the Debian packages against OSV. Debian advisories are reported against the Debian source package. Because apt reads a pinned Debian snapshot, the same commit always yields the same package versions.
licenseNote: Licences are read from the machine-readable Debian copyright file of each package and listed per component in the SBOM CSV. No licence review has been recorded yet.
criticalNote: No critical-severity assessment has been recorded yet; see the live scan figures and section 4a.
remediation: Recommended: raise DEBIAN_SNAPSHOT in root/Dockerfile (with the VERSION bump cascade) to pick up Debian security updates.

practices.practice: Upstream images pinned by digest and apt pinned to a Debian snapshot
SBOM generated per release in CycloneDX and SPDX
PR gate blocks newly introduced critical advisories
